description: This is a Java source file implementing Hibernate-specific data access object (DAO) functions for managing Form entities in the OpenMRS medical record system. It provides methods for CRUD operations, queries by various criteria, and UUID-based retrieval for Form, FormField, Field, and related entities. The class is primarily responsible for database interactions related to forms within the application.

classes.name: HibernateFormDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the FormDAO interface providing database operations for managing form-related entities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory to be used for database operations.

methods.name: saveForm
methods.description: Persists or updates a Form entity in the database.

methods.name: duplicateForm
methods.description: Creates a copy of the given Form entity by merging it into the current session.

methods.name: deleteForm
methods.description: Deletes a Form entity from the database.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves a Form entity by its ID.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Fetches all FormField entities associated with a specific Form.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Searches for Fields whose names match the given search string.

methods.name: getFieldsByConcept
methods.description: Retrieves Fields associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a Field by its ID.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Fetches all Fields, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves a FieldType by its ID.

methods.name: getAllFieldTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all FieldTypes, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a FormField by its ID.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a FormField for a specific Form and Concept, with options to ignore certain FormFields and force match.

methods.name: getAllFormFields
methods.description: Fetches all FormField entities.

methods.name: getFieldByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Field entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getFieldAnswerByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a FieldAnswer entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a FieldType entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a FieldType by its name.

methods.name: getFormByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Form entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getFormFieldByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a FormField by its UUID.

methods.name: getFormsByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Form entities matching a given name, excluding retired.

methods.name: deleteFieldType
methods.description: Deletes a specific FieldType.

methods.name: saveFieldType
methods.description: Saves or updates a FieldType entity.

methods.name: getFormFieldsByField
methods.description: Retrieves FormFields associated with a specific Field.

methods.name: getFormResource
methods.description: Retrieves a FormResource by its ID.

methods.name: getFormResourceByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a FormResource by UUID.

methods.name: saveFormResource
methods.description: Saves or updates a FormResource.

methods.name: deleteFormResource
methods.description: Deletes a FormResource.

methods.name: getFormResourcesForForm
methods.description: Gets all FormResources associated with a specific Form.
